_comment: Tier-2 for skfem nonlinear#5 (previously 'claim inherited'). Measured on skfem 12.0.1 with the stiff -lap u + exp(u) = 200 problem on MeshTri().refined(3)/P1 from a zero initial guess: full steps (alpha=1) make the residual GROW by nearly three orders of magnitude on the first step and it never recovers within the iteration budget; halving backtracking gives a monotone decrease to machine precision. Thresholds and monotonicity only, no residual pinned.
